## Shared scenes

> After preparing a lavish tea for the new minister, Mr. Allan, and his wife, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serve their guests at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste Anne's special layer cake, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) immediately demands to know what [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put in it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P36](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) beautifully decorates the tea table for Mr. and Mrs. Allan's visit, and even [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) is persuaded to join them. However, when Mrs. Allan tries Anne's cake, they discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored it with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P52](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0052)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. Friends and neighbors gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share their deep grief together. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues processing her sorrow with Mrs. Allan and sits with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who speaks of her upcoming eye exam and past romance with John Blythe.
>
